operation.change: Only rename the subclass method offset to source_offset and its two calls; reverse-transform recovers the complete original frozen operation byte-for-byte. No scientific or source-selection logic changed.
operation.permitted_output: Source SHA, unique section id, LF boundaries, 0-based character and byte offsets with exclusive ends, section-byte count, SHA-256, zero example-node count and structural validation status. The section bytes may be sliced in memory solely to compute the hash; no source prose, heading, formula, proof, example, bibliography or other source content is printed or saved.
operation.stop_conditions: Exactly one attempt. Hash mismatch, parser exception, zero/multiple A8 matches, line mismatch, invalid boundaries, any example element or any unexpected result => STOP. Do not rerun, broaden, read or reveal source content.

preconditions: Native source identity must match the same prior original HTML SHA. Program and gate hashes are checked before execution; operation may process data internally only to return the allowed structural metadata and hash, with no source-body display, saved excerpt or external access.
limits: Document-only parsing and metadata; no scientific computation. This narrow owner-authorized single attempt does not waive any other STOP/HOLD/ZERO, source/method/recipient separation requirement, global source pause elsewhere, HOLDv2, N4 UNKNOWN or auxiliary214 STOP.
